nodes.label: Android Launcher Icon (mdpi)
nodes.rationale: Medium-density (mdpi, 48x48 px) square launcher icon for the OPC Android app. It shows the default Expo/React Native template icon (Android robot head on a green rounded-square background), indicating the app still ships the stock template asset rather than a custom OPC brand icon at this density. Serves as the app identity entry point on the Android home screen / app drawer for mdpi devices.
